items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including issues that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload leading to Privilege Escalation in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical unrestricted file upload flaw (CVSS 9.6) within Adobe Commerce that requires no authentication or admin privileges to exploit, potentially leading to privilege escalation.

items.title: Unauthenticated arbitrary file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload vulnerability in the Amasty Order Attributes extension allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP object injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability (CVSS 9.8) in the Mirasvit Cache Warmer extension, which can lead to remote code execution via a crafted cookie.

items.title: Adobe Commerce DOS Vulnerability
items.summary: A denial-of-service vulnerability in Adobe Commerce, caused by a vulnerable third-party component, can be triggered remotely without authentication or user interaction, leading to application crashes.

items.title: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could allow for Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF), potentially leading to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could allow an attacker to bypass security controls.

items.title: Path Traversal in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: An improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in Adobe Commerce.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce.
